new_unit_entry.name: peripheral-primitives
new_unit_entry.scope: Twenty-four complete peripheral functions:2020B/677i,120 genuine private regions,64 direct controls and no static-address pairs or new data. Preserve ADC register masks,rank/shift paths,MAC bytes from fixed readonly addresses,clock RMW and split-halfword accesses,repeated-read counter,all signed DIV/rounding/calibration/polling operations and GP-scaled hardware delay. Only external19160 is already provided;no target/HOST/ISA execution,hardware or network. Physical silicon,private ABI,timebase,IRQ and OTA unproved.
